easyPrerequisites: All-Fates Stalker must be exiled by Phantom Steed, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, All-Fates Stalker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it exiles Yannik until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of All-Fates Stalker's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles All-Fates Stalker until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
